business.headline: Economic regulations worse than 1991, no Manmohan Singh to bail us out: ChidambaramFormer finance minister P Chidambaram criticised India's current economic model, saying regulations were worse than in 1991 and the country lacked an economic brain like Manmohan Singh. He questioned the manufacturing push, limited FTAs and shrinking competition, while calling for stronger domestic manufacturing and a more competitive economy.

India receives Rs 4,895 crore FDI after easing rules for neighbouring countriesThe government said the investments cover sectors such as information technology, artificial intelligence, manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, data centres and transport services.

India plans $1.2 billion manufacturing push to reduce China machinery dependenceIndia is finalising a $1.2 billion incentive scheme to spur local production of tunnel boring machines and other construction equipment, aimed at reducing supply risks linked to China while supporting the country's infrastructure build-out.

LIC gets green light from RBI to raise HDFC Bank stake to nearly 10%The Reserve Bank of India has allowed LIC to raise its HDFC Bank stake up to 9.99%. The approval gives LIC the room to buy more shares.

Tata Sons succession search moves into action, meetings begin to find next chiefTata Trusts chairman Noel Tata met former HDFC chairman Deepak Parekh in Mumbai as Tata Trusts begin shaping the committee to pick Tata Sons' next chairman. The move sets the succession process in motion after N Chandrasekaran decided not to seek another term.
Gold, silver jump over 5% this week: Is it still the right time to buy?With gold and silver climbing this week, investors face a tough call: chase the rally, hold their positions or cash out?

When does EPF stop earning interest? EPFO explains rules for inoperative accountsAn old EPF account should not be forgotten just because you have moved to a new job. Bengaluru couple earns Rs 2.5 lakh a month, but is trapped in debt. Here's whyA Bengaluru man's Reddit post details how a Rs 2.5 lakh monthly household income is being squeezed by EMIs, rent and credit-card bills. The account shows how heavy commitments and delayed returns from a home renovation can strain cash flow despite a high salary.

Vu launches new Glo Mini-LED TV in India: Price, features and moreVu has launched the Glo Mini-LED TV in India in four screen sizes. The set brings together AI-led picture processing, 120Hz gaming support and a photo frame mode.

IRDAI bars Niva Bupa from opening new offices for six monthsIRDAI has barred Niva Bupa Health Insurance from opening new places of business for six months over FY25 expense management breaches. Sensex, Nifty edge up after losing streak, but crude and bond yields limit gainsBenchmark indices opened marginally higher after ending their recent losing streak. The BSE Sensex was up 62.09 points, or 0.08%, at 77,599.81, while the Nifty 50 rose 16.05 points, or 0.07%, to 24,247.90 as of 10 am.

$40 trillion and counting: Why US just can't stop borrowingIt took the United States nearly two centuries to reach its first $1 trillion in debt. The latest trillion took just five months. As the country's debt pile crosses $40 trillion, the cost of paying for yesterday's borrowing is becoming one of the biggest reasons it has to keep borrowing.

entertainment.headline: Conan O'Brien tries to crack Bollywood, leaves Ali Fazal-Richa Chadha stunned Conan O'Brien tried to convince Richa Chadha and Ali Fazal that he could be a Bollywood star. His claim that he could not speak Hindi but could "sing Hindi" became the promo's standout gag.

Michael Wright, The Five Heartbeats actor, dies at 70 Michael Wright, best known as Eddie King Jr in The Five Heartbeats, has died at 70. His death marks the loss of an actor remembered for Eddie King Jr and a career across film and television.

Who is Gabriella Demetriades? Meet Arjun Rampal's wife and fashion entrepreneur Arjun Rampal and Gabriella Demetriades have formalised their relationship with a court marriage in Goa. The wedding has renewed attention on her work as a model, designer and entrepreneur.

Vibe teaser: Preity Zinta makes Kunal Kemmu, Sparsh unlikely heroes in comedy Kunal Kemmu, Sparsh Shrivastava and Preity G Zinta star in an action-comedy titled Vibe. Jailer 2's Ala Bolelo: Rajinikanth, Shamna Kasim win fans with Onam banger Jailer 2's first song Ala Bolelo, featuring Rajinikanth and Shamna Kasim, is out ahead of its October 15 release. Composed and sung by Anirudh Ravichander, the Onam-themed track is winning praise for its festive energy.

general news.headline: Will match tariffs dollar for dollar: Canada's Carney as trade talks with US failThe US and Canada failed to reach a trade deal after three days of talks, prompting Washington to impose 50% tariffs on about $28 billion worth of Canadian goods. BJP wants to stop its Trinamoolisation in Bengal.
